abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
攻击强度和法术强度提高10%，持续15秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
立即移除所有诅咒和灾祸效果，受到的所有魔法伤害降低5%，持续8秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities while an axe or two-handed axe is equipped. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 使你的所有法术和技能造成爆击的几率提高1%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Stun duration reduced by 20%.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 使你受到的昏迷效果持续时间缩短20%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (No longer an immunity.) From the BlizzCon Deep Dive slide.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 2分钟冷却时间
立即移除所有魅惑、恐惧和催眠效果。

abilities.abilityDesc: 5 yd, 2 min cooldown. Regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec from a Humanoid or Undead corpse; moving, acting or taking damage cancels it. From the Deep Dive slide.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
5码距离 | 瞬发 | 2分钟冷却时间
激活之后，每2秒回复总生命值的7%和总法力值的7%，持续10秒。只能对半径5码范围内的人型生物或亡灵的尸体使用。在食尸时进行移动、做出任何动作或受到任何伤害都会中断这个效果。

abilities.abilityDesc: Breathe underwater 300% longer.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 在水下呼吸的时间延长300%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Your spells and attacks have a 5% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. From the Deep Dive slide.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 你的法术和攻击有几率吸取目标生命值，最多相当于你最大生命值的5%：战士、圣骑士、潜行者触发几率为20%，牧师、法师、术士为30%。内置冷却25秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
0.5秒施法时间 | 90秒冷却时间
使身边半径8码范围内的最多5个敌人昏迷，持续2秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Grow bonus herbs without Herbalism.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发
栽培附近的一株草药，生长出一株无需草药学技能即可采集的复制品。每株草药只能栽培一次。

abilities.abilityDesc: Gain increased movement speed the longer you keep moving.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 移动时每5秒使移动速度提高1%，最高可提高30%。受到伤害或站立不动会降低此效果。此外，骑乘时移动速度提高3%。

abilities.abilityDesc: +5% total Health, +1% Hit Chance.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 总生命值提高5%，爆击伤害和治疗加成提高2%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
使你的施法和攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec; any movement, action or damage taken cancels it. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
需引导 | 3分钟冷却时间
在6秒内恢复最大生命值的50%。任何移动、动作或受到伤害都会取消该效果。

abilities.abilityDesc: +5% damage vs Beasts.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 对野兽的伤害提高5%。

abilities.abilityDesc: 10% of Health regen continues in combat.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 生命值回复速度提高20%，在战斗中仍可保持20%的生命值回复速度。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 90秒冷却时间
在半空中滑翔下降，持续10秒，并可控制移动方向。

abilities.abilityDesc: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Draw power from a convergence of elements: +10% movement and mounted speed for 30 sec, or 15 min if a convergence is nearby. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
0.5秒施法时间 | 2分钟冷却时间
尝试汲取元素交汇处的力量以获取祝福，使移动速度和骑乘速度提高10%。若附近没有元素交汇处，持续30秒；若有，则持续15分钟。

abilities.abilityDesc: Passive. 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 法术、近战和远程急速提高3%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Passive. Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 对元素生物造成的伤害提高5%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
立即移除所有昏迷效果。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
提高潜行侦测能力，持续20秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Passive. +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, auto attacks included, while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. Read off Soda's Warrior tooltip.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 使你的所有法术和攻击造成爆击的几率提高2%。

abilities.abilityDesc: +5% Spirit.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 精神提高5%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. From the Deep Dive slide.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
立即移除并免疫所有流血、中毒和疾病效果，并使受到的所有物理伤害降低10%，持续8秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Sense nearby treasure and show it on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发
使矮人可以感知附近宝藏的位置，并将其显示在微缩地图上。直到主动取消。

abilities.abilityDesc: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace or two-handed mace is equipped.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 使你的爆击伤害和治疗加成提高2%。

abilities.abilityDesc: +5% damage vs Beasts.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 对野兽造成的伤害提高5%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 3分钟冷却时间
使你的所有法术和攻击的爆击几率提高10%，持续15秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Slip into the shadows until you move; Night Elf Rogues and Druids stealth as if 1 level higher. Usable in combat: enemies are discouraged from attacking you, but the cooldown becomes 2 min. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 10秒冷却时间
激活后潜入暗影之中，降低敌人发现你的几率。持续直到取消或移动。在战斗中使用此技能会降低敌人攻击你的意愿，但冷却时间延长至2分钟。

abilities.abilityDesc: +1% Dodge, +2% run speed.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 躲闪几率提高1%，移动速度提高2%。暗夜精灵潜行者和德鲁伊在潜行时更难被发现，效果相当于潜行等级提高1级。

abilities.abilityDesc: +75% speed while dead.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 死后变成小精灵，移动速度提高75%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Escape any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to them for 3 sec. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 2分钟冷却时间
立即摆脱任何限制移动效果的影响，并对这些效果免疫，持续3秒。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next 3 damaging or healing abilities cost 50% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Read from the demo; a Warlock's tooltip only lists the damage half.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 2分钟冷却时间
潜行者：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的能量减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
术士：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的法力值减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
牧师：你的非周期性伤害或治疗技能法力消耗降低10%，造成的伤害或治疗量提高10%。
法师：你的伤害技能消耗的法力值减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。
战士：你的非周期性伤害技能消耗的怒气减少10%，造成的伤害提高10%。

abilities.abilityDesc: +5% Mana, Rage and Energy.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
牧师, 法师, 术士：最大法力值提高5%。
潜行者：最大能量值提高5%。
战士：最大怒气值提高5%。

abilities.abilityDesc: More reliable engineering devices.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 你的侏儒才智使你在使用工程学装置时出现故障或发生反冲的几率降低20%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
瞬发 | 90秒冷却时间
在半空中滑翔下降，持续10秒，并可控制移动方向。

abilities.abilityDesc: 2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Tap a nearby ley line for +100% Health and Mana regeneration: 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, 15 min if one is found. Read from the demo.
abilities.abilityDescCn:
2秒施法时间 | 2分钟冷却时间
尝试引动附近魔网的力量，使生命与法力恢复速度提高100%。若附近没有魔网，持续30秒；若有，则持续15分钟。可在移动中施放。

abilities.abilityDesc: Passive. 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 法术、近战和远程急速提高3%。

abilities.abilityDesc: Passive. Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.
abilities.abilityDescCn: 对元素生物造成的伤害提高5%。
